name: loupe
description: Loupe — design-system conformance for agent-written UI. Install this marketplace to get the plugin.

plugins.name: loupe
plugins.description: Keeps agent-written wp-admin interfaces on the WordPress Design System. An authoring skill that sets the rules before the first draft, a conformance engine that correlates JSX component bindings with the CSS styling them — across stylesheets, inline styles and CSS-in-JS — names the exact token that replaces a hardcoded value, and catches composites rebuilt across files, plus hooks that report drift at write time rather than at review time.
